verdicts.reason: Both have the same faults: the yellow sun-circle is shrunk to a small blob that collides with the Try It button and is cut off at the top-right edge, the can is tiny and stranded far left (its FIZZ BANG label is unreadable), and the middle has wide dead gaps. A is worse because its tagline is left-shifted and doesn't line up with the Cherry Bang headline. B centres the tagline under the headline, so the copy block is aligned.
